$comment: Archives that hold the parish registers of the Czech lands, by district (okres) as in 1960-2000. Edit only this file to change an archive, its districts or its portal. District names must match app/data/districts.geojson; scripts/build-data.mjs fails if a district has no archive. placeSearchUrl is a URL with {name} for the Municipality name, or null where no place-search pattern has been verified. color is the tint of the archive regions layer. municipalityOverrides is written by scripts/build-data.mjs (do not edit it by hand): Municipalities that keep the archive of their older district.
